action.objective: Verify e3xd4, the exact broad-search best (-89 at depth 3), by forcing the pawn capture line and resolving the trades on d4.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 3 gave e3d4 the only exact score (-89), but alternatives were upper bounds, so no like-for-like comparison exists. e3d4 wins a pawn (d4 is a pawn) and opens the d-file for the d1 rook. Verification at max depth 4 with the reserved 2000 nodes checks whether Black's c6/b6/d4 structure wins material back.
